links.outcome: Criterion-level accuracy of deployed LLM outputs versus coordinator review
links.effect: Accuracy 0.94 (95% CI 0.92-0.96), sensitivity 0.98, specificity 0.81, PPV 0.95, NPV 0.93, F1 0.97 across 5,096 criteria reviewed by coordinators.
links.quote: Aggregated individual criterion-level performance: accuracy 0.94 (95% CI, 0.92–0.96), sensitivity 0.98 (0.97–0.99), specificity 0.81 (0.71–0.88), PPV 0.95 (0.92–0.97), NPV 0.93 (0.90–0.95), F1 0.97 (0.95–0.97).

unlisted_practices: Automated prompt updating from coordinator feedback (27 criteria prompts across 14/26 trials)
Sorting patient review lists by LLM-derived eligibility likelihood to prioritize coordinator review

screen.reason: The study prospective evaluated a real deployment of an LLM-assisted clinical trial prescreening workflow incorporating human-in-the-loop coordinator review and iterative prompt updates based on coordinator feedback.

primary.practice: human-in-the-loop coordinator review and feedback-driven prompt updating
